result.rationale: refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response on the sync branch (line 'return response;') while the local branch returns parsed/gaxios-style objects (e.g. HubSpot gets `hubspotClient.oauth.tokensApi.createToken` result whose properties are read directly, Google gets `fetchTokens.res` whose `.data` is read). Callers like HubspotCalendarService/Lark then read fields off the result directly (e.g. `hubspotRefreshToken.refresh_token`, `handleLarkError(resp, ...)`) — a raw fetch Response has none of those, so with credential sharing enabled the refresh flow breaks for those apps.
